FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS
BMS BLOCK–II, SOUTH CAMPUS, SECTOR-25, PANJAB UNIVERSITY,
CHANDIGARH-160014
Advertisement for one post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
Applications are invited for One (01) position of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in the Indian Council
of Medical Research (ICMR) sponsored research project entitled “In vivo antibacterial efficacy of encapsulated
peptide functionalized enzymatic nanomotors against Enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli induced
gastroenteritis” sanctioned to the undersigned.
No. of position: One (01)
Essential Qualifications: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree a
minimum of 55 percent marks in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields.
“Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/other national entrance test conducted by Government of India will be
preferred ”.
Desirable Experience: Prior experience in nanoparticle synthesis, various microbiological and molecular
biology techniques.
Emoluments/Fellowship: The selected candidate will be paid a stipend of Rs. 56,000 + (20% HRA).
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to 3 years based on performance. The position is
temporary and co-terminus with the project.
Age Limit: 35 years
Other relaxations as per ICMR and Panjab University norms are applicable.
How to apply:
Candidates fulfilling the above criteria may submit their application (on plain paper) to the undersigned along with
a detailed resume (with email, address and contact number), attested copies of certificates, and work experience or
publications by 10th March, 2026. The date and venue of the interview shall be conveyed via email or phone to
the eligible candidates. No separate call letter will be issued for the interview.
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with the project.
Dr. Simran Preet
Principal Investigator
Department of Biophysics
Panjab University, Chandigarh- 160014
Email: simranpreet@pu.ac.in
